prompt:
Create a native high fidelity illustrated fighting-game sprite atlas of SKULL FACE, exact original Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain (2015) incarnation, from the supplied original PS4 game captures and official PlayStation portrait. This is a living scarred human antagonist wearing formal clothing, NOT a skeleton, not a masked zombie, not a Skulls soldier, not Ground Zeroes variant. Native transparent RGBA PNG with no background. EXACTLY TWELVE entirely separate complete full-body figures in a FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW evenly spaced grid, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom. Prefer landscape 1536 x 1024. All figures wholly within cell with 40px empty alpha separation and 30px at outer edges. Fixed orthographic side/three-quarter fighting-game projection and constant standing body scale. Detailed clean hand-painted 2D game art, restrained neutral source materials. No text, cell lines, scenery, shadows, glow, smoke, auras, detached hats, blood pools, skull-monster teeth or extra people.

IDENTITY: pale grey-beige scarred burnt HUMAN face and neck, two living eyes, dark black leather DOMINO mask over both eyes with thin straps at temples, actual intact human jaw/lips/nose, NO exposed bones or skull. Black broad-brim fedora with creased crown and narrow black band stays firmly on head in all12poses. The source formal outfit is a fitted CHARCOAL/BLACK single-breasted tailored long coat with lapels and thigh-length hem (not ankle-length cloak), matching dark waistcoat, grey-beige collared shirt and narrow black tie. Small subdued original gold XOF crest/badge on ANATOMICAL LEFT breast of waistcoat only when that side visible; never Diamond Dogs diamond. Black leather FULL gloves both hands. Dark loosely tailored trousers tucked into tall BLACK WESTERN/RIDING BOOTS just below knees, restrained original diagonal stitching across shafts and textured pointed-ish toe, small heel (not bulky modern combat boot laces). No armor, no military pouches, no backpack, no holstered pistol invented. Keep source mid-thigh coat rear split and attached hems; not huge flapping cape. Source episodes show unarmed dialogue walking and gestures: these sheets use empty gloved hands, no firearm or grenade is drawn, no combat ability is claimed canonical. Undercoating scene is dark; render neutral charcoal textures readable without tinting costume blue/green. All 12 figures must face SCREEN RIGHT, including crouch/jump/KO. Independently authored anatomical view, NEVER merely flip right-side art to opposite side.

Sheet C exact twelve poses, all human physical/adapted gestures with empty gloves, no weapon: Row1 0 designation command preparation bringing a glove up at chest; 1 active command designation pointing index finger horizontally FORWARD SCREEN RIGHT with extended arm, clear gloved fingertip; 2 designation recovery retracting gesture; 3 defensive command/brace preparation raising forearms in front of chest. Row2 4 active brief defensive brace left forearm across lower face and other glove at chest; 5 brace recovery lowering forearms slightly; 6 forward CQC-grab preparation stepped stance with open gloves; 7 active forward CQC simulated control extending both open gloves forward with a short forward step, no enemy and no invisible gun. Row3 8 CQC recovery returning gloves to chest and stable stance; 9 effort recovery initiation slightly hunched head forward hands near torso; 10 straightening as breath restored; 11 relaxed recovered upright stance and hands lowered. Shoot is only historical sprite action-name for non-ballistic designation gesture. Deploy is only action-name for guarded posture; no actual deployment, grenade or particle. No psychic effects, spectral soldiers, flags, shells, ordnance or bullets. Only human pose with true alpha. ALL12 noses, gazes, front boot direction and gesture point SCREEN RIGHT. For LEFT, ALL twelve cells0..11 LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT, no RIGHT-facing figure. For RIGHT, all12faceRIGHT. Do not reflect any body atlas.
